evals.prompt: This is a fresh Next.js repo for a recipe app called Ladle. I keep a TODO.md that's getting out of hand. Give this project a vault so I can plan builds properly. Answer your own interview with sensible defaults, I'm away from the keyboard.
evals.expected_output: A roadmap vault in ladle-roadmap/ (a folder named for the project, never a bare roadmap/) with the Stop hook wired, reindex --check passing, a root CLAUDE.md section, and the TODO items offered for migration rather than invented notes.

evals.prompt: seed a second brain here for my support job. I want claims, how-tos, people and a daily note, and a page for what's in flight. Take defaults for anything else.
evals.expected_output: A brain vault at the repo root with Knowledge, Playbooks, People and Daily, Now.md, lint passing, no invented notes.

evals.prompt: The prompts in src/prompts hardcode what each tarot card means. I want to write those meanings myself in Obsidian and have the code read them. Set that up, defaults are fine.
evals.expected_output: A content vault in a folder named for the project (for example tarot-lexicon/, never a bare lexicon/) with a card type, canon.json, the status gate explained, vault.py check passing, and no definitions written by the model.
